plan.title: Order Activity records a rejected bid

steps.note: Start a buyer-side eRFX event so the test has a controlled event to act on.
Give the event a known title for traceability.
Configure the event with the RFQ stage needed for bidding and rejection.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add one line item for the vendor bid.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor so a bid can be submitted.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit the vendor bid that the buyer will reject.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted before attempting rejection.
Open the buyer's RFQ Responses view where bid rejection controls are available.
Select the submitted bid for rejection.
Reject the selected vendor bid as the buyer.
Open the RFQ Order Activity drawer after the rejection.
Verify that Order Activity contains a rejection entry.
